events.did: hissed in pain as the cuffs shocked him again and again
events.quote_anchor: MITCH hissed in pain as the cuffs shocked him again. And again.

events.did: maneuvered a knife against the cuffs until he gave up on the method after the third try
events.quote_anchor: since insanity was doing the same thing over and over and expecting a different result, he gave up on the method after the third try.

events.did: ripped the camera out of the ceiling of the van, exposing the wires behind it
events.quote_anchor: he reached up, and ripped the device out of the ceiling, exposing the wires behind.

events.did: licked his thumb and tested the exposed wire with his bound hands, eliciting a tiny spark and finding it hot
events.quote_anchor: He licked his thumb and reached his bound hands up to test the connection, eliciting a tiny spark.

events.did: held his breath and lifted the cuffs to the hot wire to fry the circuitry inside
events.quote_anchor: Holding his breath, he lifted the cuffs to the hot wire, hoping to fry the circuitry inside.

events.did: worked the deadened cuffs with the knife until they hit the van floor, then sagged doubled over in relief
events.quote_anchor: When the cuffs finally hit the van floor, he sagged, doubled over in relief.

events.did: gripped the manacles as brass knuckles and braced for a fight as the van doors swung open
events.quote_anchor: Mitch gripped the manacles like the world’s least efficient set of brass knuckles, bracing for a fight as the doors swung open.

events.did: stared in disbelief at the man's face and could only say a name, turned up into a question
events.quote_anchor: Mitch stared in disbelief. He didn’t know what to say, so all that came out was a name, the end turned up into a question.

relations.did: tensed and braced, certain the man at the door was Noah come to finish what he'd started
relations.quote_anchor: For a second, Mitch tensed, certain it was Noah, come to finish what he’d started.

relations.did: stood in the open van doorway with a gun hanging from one hand, and Mitch recognized his face
relations.quote_anchor: But then his eyes adjusted and the man’s face came into focus. Mitch stared in disbelief.

relations.did: came to the van where Mitch was held in cuffs and opened the door on him
relations.quote_anchor: A man stood, silhouetted by the pre-dawn light, which traced his edges, the outline of his sharp shoulders and short, fair hair, the gun hanging from one hand.

numbers.did: gave up on the knife method after the third try
numbers.quote_anchor: he gave up on the method after the third try.

numbers.did: wedged his sleeve fabric between wrists and cuffs between the first and second attempts
numbers.quote_anchor: He’d tried, between the first and second attempts, to wedge the fabric of his sleeves between his wrists and the cuffs,

numbers.did: his muscles locked for a second when the jolt of electricity shot through him
numbers.quote_anchor: A jolt of electricity shot through him, and for a second his muscles locked, and his vision dappled.

numbers.did: tensed for a second, certain it was Noah
numbers.quote_anchor: For a second, Mitch tensed, certain it was Noah, come to finish what he’d started.
